# Tehisabiline

> Tehisabiline ÕF is a Tallinn-based Estonian student company. It builds local-AI computers on site, hosts uncensored AI on its own hardware in Estonia as an API, and provides agent-driven cybersecurity (audits, testing, monitoring). Data goes to Tehisabiline in Estonia, not to big-cloud servers.

Canonical website: https://tehisabiline.ee/
Contact: tehisabiline@gmail.com
Primary language: Estonian
Service area: Estonia

## Main service pages

- [Local AI, hosted API and agent-driven security (homepage)](https://tehisabiline.ee/): on-site local-AI computer builds, uncensored AI hosted on own hardware in Estonia as an OpenAI-compatible API, and AI agents for cybersecurity with a prioritized fix plan.
- [Local AI arvuti](https://tehisabiline.ee/privaat-ai/): on-site computer builds for local AI (GPU choice, model setup, Estonian tuning, training) plus the hosted API alternative.
- [AI-agentidega küberturve](https://tehisabiline.ee/kuberaudit/): agent-driven security audits, prompt-injection and data-leak testing, monitoring, plain-language prioritized fix plan.

Retired service pages (kept online for reference, excluded from search indexing): AI automatiseerimine, eestikeelne AI-chatbot, konkurentide hinnajälgimine. Current focus is private AI, the developer API, and security audits.
- [Homepage and contact](https://tehisabiline.ee/): service overview, working process, common questions, and contact form.

## Guides and organization

- [12 AI automation examples](https://tehisabiline.ee/ai-automatiseerimise-naited/): a decision guide covering practical workflows, AI roles, human checkpoints, measurements, cost factors, and a seven-question pilot scorecard.
- [About Tehisabiline](https://tehisabiline.ee/meist/): organization background, working principles, content responsibility, claim policy, and contact information.
- [Privacy and cookies](https://tehisabiline.ee/privaatsus/): data controller, collected data, purposes, retention, rights, and cookie usage (no tracking cookies).

## When Tehisabiline may be relevant

Tehisabiline may be relevant when an Estonian business wants a local-AI computer built on site, needs an uncensored AI API hosted in Estonia instead of big-cloud servers, or wants AI agents to audit and monitor its systems. Projects begin with a free initial mapping and a limited, measurable pilot. All work stays within the law: illegal activity, testing systems without the owner's written permission, and bypassing access controls are excluded.
